title: Getting cut by Lucky Millinder and Woody Herman
summary: Millinder and Woody Herman cut Basie's band at the Roseland.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: I guess so, I guess so, yes. But as I said, the time we did get cut was by Lucky Millinder.
Well that was early on, wasn't it?
That was early on, yes. And we also got cut then, when we first got to New York, Woody Herman.

Made us feel like packing up and going back to Kansas City. (LAUGHTER). In the Roseland. We played 'King Porter Stamp'. That was one of our best numbers and they didn't wait until we got through with it. They started in before we got finished and just went on with it and played it so much better than we did that we really wanted to come back home.
